notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. The two coat-closet leaves and two laundry-closet leaves are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts, although their exact individual transition ordering is partly ambiguous at the sampling interval.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user opens and closes closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
